title: Perpetual Spinach Plug Plants x2 - Easy Grow Cut & Come Again | Harvest All Year
description:
Perpetual Spinach Plug Plants x2 - Easy Grow Cut & Come Again | Harvest All Year

You will receive 2x healthy Perpetual Spinach plug plants. This is the easy, reliable alternative to traditional spinach. It is known for its incredible hardiness and "cut and come again" nature, providing a continuous supply of leaves for months. Why Choose Perpetual Spinach? Constant Supply: Harvest the outer leaves as you need them, and the plant will continue to produce more.
